title: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Wenatchee Matter)

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Wenatchee Matter)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Public business and personnel records regarding the former Interim General Counsel for the Bellevue School District (BSD), Shannon M. McMinimee (WSBA #34471).

Context for Request:

Publicly available records from administrative proceedings involving the Wenatchee School District indicate a concurrent timeline of outside private practice representation by Ms. McMinimee (operating as McMinimee Law PLLC) during her active employment window with BSD (January 2022 through June 2025). Correspondence and metadata from those proceedings indicate active private case management occurring during standard public administrative business hours.

To evaluate compliance with district policies regarding outside employment, public resource use, and time accounting, I request the following records spanning January 1, 2022, through June 30, 2025:

1. Time and Attendance Logs: Timesheets, payroll hours, calendar entries, or leaves of absence (including vacation, personal, or sick time) submitted by or for Shannon McMinimee on the following specific dates where outside correspondence was recorded:
	• August 16, 2022
	• September 13, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM PT)
	• September 30, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM PT)
	• October 7, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM PT)
	• October 11, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM PT)
	• October 13, 2022 (Specifically tracking hours between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM PT)
	• February 19, 2025 (Specifically tracking hours between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM PT)

2. Outside Employment and Conflict Disclosures: Any conflict-of-interest disclosure forms, outside employment authorization requests, dual-employment waivers, or district board approval records filed by or regarding Ms. McMinimee concerning her private firm, McMinimee Law PLLC.

3. District Network/Device Activity Logs: Automated network routing logs or device metadata from district-issued computers assigned to Ms. McMinimee during the specific dates and timeframes listed in Item 1, restricted strictly to identifying whether network connections were routed to external private litigation tools, platforms, or outside administrative bodies.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kung Fu Joe

communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: DRT NW Intel
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All messages, including text, images, attachments, voice notes, and associated metadata (sender, recipients, timestamps), sent or received by any Uvalde Police Department employee or official in the following WhatsApp group chats, and in any predecessor or successor versions of them, from January 1, 2024, through the date of your search:
- "DRT NW Intel 3.0"
- "NWHG 3.0"
- "ZAV-FRIO-SIU-UVA-MED"
2. Any other WhatsApp, Signal or text-message group chats from the same period that Uvalde Police Department personnel use to exchange information with U.S. Border Patrol or U.S. Customs and Border Protection personnel. For these chats, I request the group names, creation dates, and records sufficient to show which agencies participate.
3. Any policy, general order, memorandum or guidance in effect from January 1, 2024, to the present that governs Uvalde Police Department personnel's use of WhatsApp or other messaging applications for official business, and the retention of those messages.
4. Any agreement, memorandum of understanding, or task-force or Operation Lone Star document governing information sharing between Uvalde Police Department and U.S. Border Patrol in effect during the same period.

Messages on personal devices: Under Tex. Gov't Code § 552.002(a-2), communications about official business are public information regardless of the device or account used to create or maintain them. Employees and officials who hold such communications are temporary custodians under §§ 552.003(7) and 552.233, and must surrender or preserve them. Please search personal devices and accounts where personnel used them to take part in the chats described above.

Withholding: If you believe any portion of the requested information is excepted from disclosure, please release all portions that are not excepted, and request a ruling from the Office of the Attorney General within 10 business days as required by § 552.301. Please send me a copy of any such ruling request. I am not seeking officers' personal phone numbers or home addresses, and you may redact those without an Attorney General ruling where the Act permits.

Timing and format: Please produce the information promptly under § 552.221. If you cannot produce it within 10 business days, please certify in writing the date and hour it will be available. I request electronic copies in native format, or as screenshots or exports showing sender, timestamp and full content, delivered by email or file-sharing link. Please provide records on a rolling basis.

Preservation: Please notify the relevant personnel to preserve all responsive messages while this request is pending, including messages that WhatsApp's disappearing-message settings could otherwise delete.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: BIA Agreements with Othram Inc. Regarding Forensic Genetic Genealogy and Indigenous Genomic Data
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Concerning agreements between the Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA), Office of Justice Services, Missing and Murdered Unit, and Othram Inc., including records associated with Operation Spirit Return.

Specifically, I request:

1. Blanket Purchase Agreement 140A1622A0008, including all applicable terms, conditions, and modifications.
2. Task orders 140A1623F0099, 140A1624F0056, 140A1625F0083, and 140A1626F0068, including statements of work and attachments.
3. Agreements addressing ownership, access, storage, retention, destruction, or secondary use of genetic and genomic data generated from Indigenous human remains.

7. Existing reports or exports from each ALPR system showing, by month since January 1, 2026: the number of alerts generated, the number of alerts confirmed by an officer, and the number of alerts determined to be misreads or false positives.
8. Any ALPR transparency reports or usage summaries prepared by or for the department since January 1, 2025.
9. Records reflecting the 2026 deactivation of the department's Flock cameras and network access, including the date cameras and sharing were disabled, and any instructions to or confirmations from Flock Safety regarding deletion, export, or retention of the department's data after deactivation.

Please release all non-exempt portions and cite the specific statutory exception for anything withheld. If any item is unclear, please contact me for clarification rather than denying it.

I request records in their existing electronic format (such as native exports, CSV, or PDF) delivered by email or download link. I do not request paper copies, printouts, or physical media such as CDs or flash drives. I am not requesting that new reports be created. Please do not refer me to an online transparency portal in place of producing these records.

I request a waiver or reduction of fees, as release of this information primarily benefits the general public by informing residents about the use of surveillance technology in their community. If charges will exceed $40, please provide an itemized estimate, including any less costly alternative, before work begins.

Thank you for your cooperation. I look forward to your prompt response, as required by the Texas Public Information Act.

Sincerely,
Blackland Prairie Records Project

title: Mayor Lurie: Trump call, federal deployment, and PG&E blackout communications

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Mayor Lurie: Trump call, federal deployment, and PG&E blackout communications
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The records are listed from most specific to most general. Please produce them on a rolling basis in the order listed, releasing the earlier items as soon as they are ready rather than holding them until the later, broader items are searched.

1. The date, time and duration of the phone call(s) between Mayor Daniel Lurie and President Trump on or about October 22, 2025, including call logs and calendar entries.
2. Records identifying everyone on that call (aides, staff, officials or private individuals) and their affiliations.
3. Any audio recordings or transcripts of that call.
4. Notes, memos or summaries of that call made by the Mayor's Office or any other City department.
5. All text messages between Mayor Lurie and PG&E's Jake Zigelman, December 19-31, 2025, as a complete thread with all timestamps, including the messages before and after the December 21, 2025 "opera house update" message.
6. The full group message thread started by Ned Segal on December 20, 2025 about the citywide blackout and the War Memorial Opera House (reportedly including Branislav Henselmann, Mary Ellen Carroll and Kate Sofis), from its start through December 31, 2025.
7. All text messages between Mayor Lurie and PG&E CEO Patti Poppe, December 19, 2025 through January 31, 2026.
8. All emails between Mayor Lurie and Jake Zigelman, December 19-31, 2025.
9. All text messages between Alicia John-Baptiste and Jake Zigelman, December 19-31, 2025.
10. All emails between Alicia John-Baptiste and Jake Zigelman, December 19-31, 2025.
11. Communications between the Mayor's Office and the Department of Homeland Security, ICE, CBP or any other federal agency about the planned federal deployment to San Francisco or its cancellation, October 8-31, 2025.
12. Communications with technology executives or other private individuals about the deployment, the call with President Trump, or efforts to influence the President's decision, October 8-31, 2025.
13. Communications from federal officials confirming or changing the deployment plans, October 8-31, 2025.
14. Records underlying the Mayor's public statement that the President told him the deployment was called off, and any follow-up documentation or internal evaluation of the cancellation.
15. Records of any verbal or written understanding between the Mayor's Office (or the City) and the federal government about the cancellation, and any City policy changes or commitments made as part of, or following, the call.
16. Records the City received giving notice of the planned deployment (dates, expected personnel, scope).
17. Records of the Mayor's October 22, 2025 executive directive and any other City preparations for the deployment.
18. Internal City memos assessing the deployment's impact on City operations, public safety or immigrant communities.
19. Coordination records among City departments (for example DEM, SFPD and the City Attorney) about preparing for or responding to federal action, October 8-31, 2025.
20. Emails, text messages, chat messages and memos that mention the call with President Trump or the planned federal deployment or its cancellation, October 8-31, 2025, including messages within the Mayor's Office, with other City officials, and with federal officials.
21. All emails sent or received by anyone in the Mayor's Office about the December 2025 blackouts or power restoration, December 19-31, 2025.
22. Any other written communications (emails, texts, chats, memos) between the Mayor or Mayor's Office staff and PG&E about the outages, December 20, 2025 through the date this request is fulfilled.

This request includes records on personal phones or accounts used for City business. Please provide text messages as complete threads with timestamps and sender/recipient, not cropped screenshots. If any record or part of a record is withheld, please identify it. Please also tell me which numbered items have no responsive records.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson
